beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: The hundred chart is counting, in rows of ten.

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Eleven starts the next row, right under one.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Then the rest pours in: thirty, forty, fifty, sixty, seventy, eighty, ninety, one hundred.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Look down one column.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Four, fourteen, twenty-four.

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: Thirty-four! They all end in four.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: One step down is ten more. The ones stay, and the tens count up.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: This is part of the hundred chart. What number belongs in the empty square?

do.text: This is part of the hundred chart. What number belongs in the empty square?

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Start at sixty-three.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: One step right is one more.

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: Sixty-three, sixty-four. The square is sixty-four.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Check from above: fifty-four.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: One step down is ten more: sixty-four.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: This empty square starts a row. Nothing is on its left.

do.text: At the start of a row

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: So look up.

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: Thirty-one, and ten more is forty-one.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: This empty square ends a row.

do.text: At the end of a row

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: Forty-seven, forty-eight, forty-nine, forty-ten.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: After nine ones comes a new ten. Look up: forty.

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: Ten more than forty is fifty. Forty-nine, then fifty.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: One step right is one more.

do.text: One step right is one more.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: One step down is ten more.

do.text: One step down is ten more.
